about.aboutText:
Brandor is a creative branding, media production, and storytelling agency dedicated to helping organizations, businesses, institutions, and development partners communicate their impact with clarity, creativity, and purpose.

We believe every project, every event, and every initiative has a story worth telling. Our role is to transform moments, achievements, and ideas into compelling visual experiences that inspire trust, engagement, and action.

From corporate branding and media production to event documentation, strategic storytelling, and capacity building, we help our clients showcase their work professionally while creating meaningful connections with their audiences.
about.mission: To empower brands, organizations, and communities through strategic branding, impactful storytelling, professional media production, and capacity-building initiatives that drive visibility, growth, and lasting impact.
about.vision: To become Africa's leading creative agency for branding, storytelling, and impact documentation, helping organizations communicate their value, amplify their achievements, and inspire positive change.

projects.title: BUILDATHON
projects.description:
NCC BUILDATHON Three-Day Event

Brandor provided media documentation for the three-day NCC Buildathon, capturing the energy, creativity, and collaboration throughout the event.

Through photography, video coverage, and interviews, we documented participants at work, project presentations, and key highlights creating visual content for event reporting, storytelling, and future promotion.

projects.title: Business Communication Masterclass
projects.description:
Business Communication Masterclass

Brandor delivered professional media coverage for the two-day Business Communication Masterclass organised by Falconmax Training and Consulting Nigeria Limited.

Our coverage included photography, video highlights, participant interviews, training sessions, networking moments, and award ceremonies. We captured the learning experience and key celebrations, creating engaging content for documentation, storytelling, and future promotion.

projects.title: Inclusive Digital Empowerment For Youths With Disabilities
projects.description:
Inclusive Digital Empowerment for Youths with Disabilities is a flagship program under The Ability First Tech Hub, sponsored by Plan International, aimed at equipping 50 youths with disabilities with essential digital skills and knowledge to enhance their employability, entrepreneurship, and participation in the digital economy.

Brandor provided comprehensive media, branding, and documentation support throughout the entire project lifecycle. Our involvement covered every stage of the program, from the Inception Meeting and Training Manual Review to the Digital Skills Training Sessions and Graduation Ceremony.

Our scope of work included:

• Designing promotional and event flyers.
• Capturing high-quality photographs of all project activities.
• Developing compelling photo stories that highlighted participants' experiences, achievements, and impact.
• Producing videos that documented key moments of the project.
• Conducting and recording interviews with participants, facilitators, and stakeholders to showcase success stories and project outcomes.

Through strategic storytelling and visual documentation, Brandor helped amplify the impact of the program, ensuring that the voices, journeys, and achievements of the participants were effectively communicated to stakeholders and the wider community.
